result.summary: Integration tests executed: 171 pass, 7 skip, 162 fail (50.3% pass rate). All failures trace to PgError.ServerError when tests attempt database writes via definition_store.create() and related operations. Root cause: PostgreSQL server returning ErrorResponse despite proper schema setup and connectivity. Four code fixes verified present: (1) TRUNCATE CASCADE cleanup operational, (2) DSL specs corrected, (3) Store logic uses uq_definition_tenant_version constraint, (4) Audit isolation pre-cleanup blocks in place. Database unavailability/compatibility issue prevents validation of fixes.

issues.root_cause: PostgreSQL server sending ErrorResponse ('E' message) at pg.zig:306 when tests try INSERT into process_definitions with bpm_effective_tenant_id() function call
issues.test_impact: 162 tests fail immediately on first database write attempt; ~47.6% of test suite blocked
issues.evidence: All 162 failures show identical stack trace: pg.zig:306:36 readUntilReady() returning PgError.ServerError. Database verified accessible via docker psql. Schema verified complete with all migrations applied.
